text:
9. 2. 5. 1

Navasaññā suttaṃ

(Sāvatthinidānaṃ)

Rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya nava dhammā bhāvetabbā. Katame nava: asubhasaññā, maraṇasaññā, āhāre paṭikkūlasaññā, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā, aniccasaññā, anicce dukkhasaññā. Dukkhe anattasaññā, pahānasaññā, virāgasaññā. Rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya ime nava dhammā bhāvetabbāti.
